rationale: The canonical candidate identity independently recomputes to sha256:bb2ea18f2a53885cb60b45d8a54c8d25e47a5b9e93c7c091a5948903b1bcf7a6, and the reviewed plan bytes match git:97becd37ba2e99055f13c97ad6780eb06c8d0e34. The earlier authorization hard stops are discharged: protected-surface transitions bind and re-derive every covered digest and file, while weave freshness now uses non-self-referential closure and history digests with external exact-commit attestation. I explicitly ratify SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM: the constrained declarative-oracle design, structural exclusion of imperative lookup-table oracles, mandatory pre-implementation merge gate for the concrete grammar/evaluator, and affirmative required-seat-plus-Eye source review with the determinized battery as the interim are acceptable within the repository’s human trust-root boundary. I also ratify the pre-review dispositions carried into this plan: Option-A re-authorization, reconcile-and-supersede authority repair, exceptionless auditing, the production-profile default flip, and deferral of the private-package naming fallback. The remaining Phase-1b and browser/npm-distribution items are honestly registered rather than silently claimed. E1–E6, the governance bootstrap, Phase-0/1a contract, release ceremony, and atomic weave sequencing are mutually consistent and fail closed at their stated boundaries. Council approval remains review evidence; implementation still requires the separate Eye authority grant.
